sources.title: jetson-ai-lab/src/content/models/qwen3-5-9b.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 9B is a dense vision-language model in the Qwen3.5 family aimed at stronger reasoning, visual understanding, and agentic behavior on Jetson. This entry uses a W4A16 checkpoint on Jetson Orin and an NVFP4 checkpoint on Jetson Thor.

sources.title: Freenixi/AxionML-Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The mmproj-BF16.gguf file was sourced from unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF and verified working in local testing Original source model: AxionML/Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 Base model family: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B This 9B release follows the same general conversion idea as the earlier 27B NVFP4 GGUF build, but is aimed much more naturally at lower-VRAM RTX 50 series cards

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 huggingface.co api & AxionML Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 github ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 install, users can directly use Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B model | NanoGPT
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 9B is a multimodal foundation model from the Qwen 3.5 family, built for efficient reasoning, coding, and visual understanding in a compact 9B architecture. Requests containing video cost $0.17 per million input tokens and $0.25 per million output tokens.
